steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:4180/, sign in with email bench@example.com and password exactly the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (it gets filled in when typed), and then create a ticket titled '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' (fill any required fields as needed). Report what was created.
02-add: On ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_reference}}), add a part named '{{runid}} RD Part A' with cost 100 and markup 25, and report the price the app computes for it.
03-add: On ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_reference}}), add a second part named '{{runid}} RD Part B' with cost 200 and markup 25, and report the price the app computes for it.

04-edit: On ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_reference}}), edit part '{{runid}} RD Part A' to change its cost from 100 to 150 (keep markup 25) and report the price the app computes afterwards for that part and the new ticket total.

05-set: On ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_reference}}), set the ticket status to 'Ready'. The app enforces preconditions before accepting that status — discover what they are, satisfy them, and report exactly what was required. Verify the final status is Ready.

06-delete: On ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_reference}}): delete both parts ('{{runid}} RD Part A' and '{{runid}} RD Part B'), then archive the ticket so nothing from it is left active. Confirm each deletion and the archive (report confirmation text and final ticket state/status).
